description: Korean industrial accident disability benefit (산재보험법 제57조, 시행령 별표 2): days by grade 1-14 × daily average wage clamped to the 2026 maximum 268,299 / minimum 82,560 KRW; grades 1-3 pension only, 4-7 pension or lump sum (with break-even years), 8-14 lump sum only; pension advance (선급) and the 5-year claim deadline from the healing date (제112조). Estimate only; grades are decided by 근로복지공단.
name: calculate_kr_injury_disability_benefit
title: Calculate Korea injury disability benefit
